basic_info.description: This classic Marina-style home sits on an extra deep lot in a prime Eureka Valley location, just blocks to Dolores Park. The updated home offers an abundance of natural light, beautiful period detailing, refinished wood floors and modern updates. The foyer leads to a spacious living/dining room with gorgeous refinished wood floors, period details and a handsome wood-burning fireplace.The remodeled kitchen with quartz counters, stainless appliances include a Viking gas range and KitchenAid refrigerator and tile backsplash opens to the rear garden. 2 spacious bedrooms and 2 remodeled bathrooms. The home enjoys a deep south-facing garden with multiple decks and mature foliage. One-car garage with washer/dryer and storage. Ideal Eureka Valley location close to Dolores Park and neighborhood schools, and all the shopping, cafes and restaurants of the Castro, Upper Market and Mission Dolores. Easy access to public transit, tech shuttles and freeways
